scope: Current semantic/partial-proof review of every exact fragment in REQUIREMENTS All songs/Albums and the complete M5 result. Canonical groups retain compound conditions rather than turn text fragments into scored tests.

groups.outcome: One coherent ordered catalog with unique songs/albums and totals.
groups.judgment: Current complete-root union deduplicates canonical IDs,sorts before slicing and retains two completed query snapshots. In-flight same-view reads share work;unrelated views do not invalidate session ownership. Single-root paths retain provider ordering. Renderer deduplication is supplementary,not proof of correct server totals.
remaining: Historical controlled overlap and dated live single-root evidence retain their topology/server-mutation limits;not exhaustive real-server snapshot isolation.

groups.outcome: Find song title/artist/album and album title/album-artist matches within selected libraries.
groups.judgment: Current search explicitly expands artist and album matches and deduplicates before sorting/paging;album artist uses AlbumArtistIds. Album expansion verifies returned AlbumId. Filters remain in base parameters. Over10000 matches fail with a narrowing instruction rather than a truncated result.
remaining: Retained native/live tests are dated and scoped;an uncoached finding-music task and arbitrary server search semantics are not established by source inspection.

groups.trigger: Select rows,act on selection or leave/return to an album
groups.outcome: Play/Queue/Add use displayed order and preserve only the intended temporary selection.
mandatoryVariants: Duplicate playlist occurrence semantics remain separate
Back and fresh open clear album selection
groups.judgment: TrackTable derives bulk songs by filtering rows rather than Map insertion order. ReadyApp owns transient selection across page unmounts. Album open/Back and library updates explicitly reset Maps;account-keyed SessionContent and process restart discard them. Shared fragment links to MUS08 retain its focus clauses.
remaining: Every compound selection/focus clause remains required;dated action and selection runs are retained with their controlled/live boundaries rather than recast as one current end-to-end pass.

groups.trigger: Browse sparse or full metadata and open details
groups.outcome: Show usable music metadata and missing-value fallbacks without editing server metadata.
groups.judgment: Current mapping handles absent strings/arrays and inspector uses selected metadata during detail loading/failure. Duration visibility is separate from its numeric fallback in MUS05. Track rows expose title/artist names;no metadata editor is exposed.
remaining: Source review does not establish all artwork revisions on every server or subjective legibility;retained native/live metadata cases remain scoped.

groups.outcome: Use a finite actual-resource total only on the current occurrence;unknown total disables seeking.
groups.judgment: Current measured-duration patch preserves occurrence key/track ID and checks generation,current source and current occurrence. Conversion offset contributes to total;catalog duration bypasses the patch. This is not proof of physical system seek delivery.
remaining: M16/M17 actual OS-mediated controls remain open. Codec/native/live records retain their substitutions,representative-format and acoustic-position limits.

groups.trigger: Open an album including empty or failed metadata
groups.outcome: Read current album by ID and an ordered track list;available tracks stay usable.
groups.judgment: AlbumDetail separates metadata and track queries,retains supplied album metadata while unavailable and enables actions from tracks alone. albumTracks requests disc/track/name ordering. MUS03 additionally governs selection ordering.
remaining: Dated six-track live album and controlled empty/error cases do not establish every server or every album ordering variant.

groups.trigger: Browse,page or select a large collection
groups.outcome: Keep browsing responsive at the actual library size.
mandatoryVariants: Virtualized song rows and album grid
groups.judgment: Both views virtualize visible content plus focused/recovery targets. Multi-root cold reads materialize the complete union;two completed views are cached. This deliberate cost remains part of the requirement rather than being hidden by DOM virtualization.
remaining: Existing measured controlled and actual-library evidence retains its exact sizes/runtime. This audit adds no performance measurement or guarantee for larger libraries.

groups.trigger: Search,arrow through rows,open/return from a collection
groups.outcome: Focus remains named,visible and owned by the current action;passive updates do not reclaim it.
mandatoryVariants: Focused tile opens at top on Back before data
Playlist Back exact tile or heading
Background data never replays entry focus
groups.judgment: Current layout/focus ownership checks visible window,origin,location and overlays. Row arrow handling follows current focused index;virtualizers retain target rows. Command-F accepts only the plain macOS chord. Q06 evidence does not substitute for Q09 spoken VoiceOver operation.
remaining: Q09 VoiceOver remains External. Exact current all-state focus behavior is not newly replayed by this static audit;retained native keyboard evidence keeps its stated source/state limits.

groups.trigger: Refresh or retry a failed initial/page read
groups.outcome: Keep available data and focused recovery controls;successful owned recovery reaches relevant results.
mandatoryVariants: Retry first new item or empty heading
Background refresh does not move focus
Refresh does not prepare or enable radio
groups.judgment: Current refresh invalidates all named catalog/detail caches without clearing view selection. A synchronous in-flight ref guards refresh repeats. Shared retry ownership cancels focus handoff on later interaction while the read continues;virtualizers reserve the first appended item.
remaining: No new current native retry/page run is claimed;dated recovery proofs retain their exact variants. Listener comprehension of recovery remains separate.

STARContext.story: I can find music and recover from a failed page
STARContext.situationAndTask: I am browsing a growing library or narrowing it by artist, album, genre or tag
STARContext.action: Use Command-F to search, filter, select songs, open an album and return; Retry if the next page fails
STARContext.expectedResult: Focused song rows identify their title and artist, including missing-metadata fallbacks; loaded-count fallback destinations expose their visible count. Keep keyboard-focused rows/controls visible above the selection toolbar and player in songs, albums and playlists; quick arrow presses retain every move; show each song/album once across overlapping selected libraries, with unique totals and coherent pages; concurrent sort/filter reads of an unchanged selection do not falsely claim the library changed; Refresh rereads the server after a completed read, retains its focused action through busy/success/failure, ignores repeated activation while busy and leaves later Tab navigation in place; reset selection for a different search/filter; retain song selection and the same open album's track selection through ordinary page navigation; opening an album or playlist from its focused tile starts at the top on Back before reads finish; data updates leave later focus alone and sidebar return keeps its focus/scroll; Back closes the album, clears its selection and restores its tile focus even after a page detour; focused playlist Back restores that exact tile or the list heading when unavailable; opening from the list starts fresh, and library/account changes or restart clear temporary album selection; keep loaded songs/albums visible during a paging failure with explicit Retry; keyboard recovery focuses visible recovered results, the first new item after paging, or the heading of an empty page; failed retry retains its action, while later focus/navigation wins and background refreshes keep focus

method: Read current contract,source owners and selected dated evidence fields/scopes/limits. Each group has an actor,trigger,outcome,mandatory variants,explicit checks and current source judgment.
Historical artifacts are evidence entry points,not re-executions or whole-group acceptance. Current source hashes identify this inspection;they do not refresh old native/live proofs.

Each of52 fragments is reciprocally linked. Overlapping group links retain independent conditions such as selection plus focus or album actions plus metadata. The whole M5 story/action/result remains intact.
limits: No production code change,new native/service/live/provider/performance/VoiceOver/listener result or repeated build/type/lint/unit check.
Current source appears aligned within this reviewed boundary;runtime completeness remains unproved. Named OS,audible,listener and broad platform checks remain open.
Other PRD sections,whole-story acceptance and all7 parent gates retain their scope. This review does not accept parent criterion2,which also requires playlist behavior.
No deferred smaller-window or enlarged-zoom work.
